title: RSVP reply
description: A persona's joining reply for one round or one gate (chorus-review Phase 0.5; DECISION-PRIMITIVE.md § The RSVP signal, § Seating). At most 80 words of prose across reason, hook, applies and uncovered_delta.

schema_version.description: Schema version; the major must be 1.

lens.description: The lens the persona would bring.

round.description: Which round or gate this reply is for, e.g. '2026-09-27' or 'gate-A/cycle-1'. A reply never carries to another gate (S2).

decision.description: JOIN, ABSTAIN, or EXCEPTIONAL (exceptional entry beyond the cap of five). The persona's call, never the conductor's (I2).

applies.description: Axis A — applicability: concrete round-context deltas the lens touches, cited. Empty means not applicable.

hook.description: One-line evidence hook for the stakes.

uncovered_delta.description: EXCEPTIONAL only: the concrete round-context delta no seated ordinary lens covers. Distinct entries must cite distinct deltas.
